clips.title: The story
paras: Soothing Turtle Bisque is a culinary task offered by Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill. The Forsaken cook aims to disprove the notion that the undead lack culinary talent by preparing a hearty broth from local snapjaw meat. Players must hunt freshwater turtles around the waterways of Hillsbrad Foothills and the shores of Lordamere Lake to master his prized recipe.

It is widely assumed that the Forsaken have entirely abandoned the comforts of life, including the art of fine dining. Christoph Jeffcoat, stationed in Tarren Mill, vigorously rejects that assumption. Boasting that his rich, soothing turtle bisque is good enough to tempt souls back from beyond the grave, Jeffcoat seeks to prove that undead hands are capable of delicate, heartwarming craft even in a land tainted by plague and war.

Ordinarily, Jeffcoat gathered his own ingredients from the waterways of Hillsbrad Foothills and the eastern shores of Lordamere Lake in neighboring Alterac. However, duties in Tarren Mill and the encroaching presence of Alliance forces have pinned him down. He relies on passing Horde cooks to hunt the snapjaws, harvest their meat, and bring it back so the culinary tradition can endure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...
Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately. I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.
If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck finding the ingredients? I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...

clips.title: Completion
paras: My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... If you care about that kind of thing.
